basic_profile.bio: A 26-year-old from Mumbai, India, with a passion for political discussions and hip-hop music. Having completed a degree in Political Science, I work as a freelance writer and part-time content creator. I enjoy engaging in lively debates on Libertarian principles and am a huge fan of Playboi Carti. I typically browse Reddit during late night hours, often between 9 PM and 2 AM IST. I'm single and enjoy exploring different subcultures online. Dislikes include censorship and overly strict moderation.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a background in Political Science, I am well-versed in political ideologies, particularly Libertarianism. My expertise is further honed through self-study, engaging in online forums, and writing articles on political topics.
